## Appearance

A man of plain appearance, he has a tall and somewhat awkward form, though he appears extremely weak and stooped by the spring. His closely shaved face is bronzed and heavily furrowed, featuring deep-set, exceptionally blue eyes and thick iron-gray hair that hangs to his shoulders.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P6](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P11](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0011)_

## Personality

Captain Saul is an exceptionally good-humored, calm, and splendid spirit who possesses a fervent adoration for beauty and a tendency to be interfering. He is philosophically minded, enjoying reflection upon all manner of issues even when he cannot resolve them. Additionally, he is a decently skilled fiddle player and a talented natural narrator gifted in telling entertaining tales, though he harbors a nauseating dread of a drawn-out end.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P61](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0061), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P5](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P49](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P3](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), +4 more_

## History

As a boy, Uncle Saul ran off to sea soon after his parents' marriage, beginning a life spent entirely at sea until five years before settling at [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls). During his nautical career, he saved his cat, the First Mate, and discovered [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md) in [Havana](../codex/places.md#havana). After retiring to [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point) light, he welcomed [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh to the area, frequently sharing local history and stories from his ocean-faring life. Over the years, he spent many evenings entertaining visitors like [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md), and [Ambrose Kerr](../character/ambrose.md) at the lighthouse and during holiday gatherings. Following the death of Nell's infant daughter [Joyce](../character/joyce.md), Saul comforted her by revealing the story of his beloved [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), whom he had lost at sea over fifty years prior. When [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) arrived, Saul discovered the young man was the grandson of Damaris [Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md) and lent him his personal life log. Adrian spent the summer writing Saul's life story and the tale of [Margaret](../character/margaret.md) into a book, which Saul eagerly awaited and eventually celebrated when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) delivered the completed volume. After contemplating his mortality and asking [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to care for his cat after his passing, Saul gave his blessing to Adrian and Lorna's engagement. Shortly thereafter, Saul passed away peacefully in his sleep at the lighthouse with his life-book resting on his chest, having willed his collection of oddities to Little Kit.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P16](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P48](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0048), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063), +50 more_

## Quotes

> "Nephew Hector. His understanding of it matches my own. Well, now, I am truly pleased that you invited me to remain for supper. My hunger is quite strong—I ate very little for dinner today."
>
> — Uncle Saul — [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P19](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0019)

> "Listen, my usual way of living is royal. Up at the Glen yesterday evening, two pounds of steak were bought by me to bring back. Today, my intention was to enjoy an extraordinarily fine dinner."
>
> — Uncle Saul — [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P21](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0021)

> "Indeed, I fear that is the case. I really dislike it. It gives me the impression that there might be something rather unnatural concerning myself."
>
> — Uncle Saul — [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P42](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0042)

> “Probably—probably,” agreed Captain Saul. “That’s what I remarked to him back then. Thinking that was a great deal more reassuring. I disliked the thought of him perceiving stuff of that nature—it felt truly strange.”
>
> — Uncle Saul — [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P16](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0016)

> "Those were the words he used. I recall them just as if it happened yesterday, even if I was not entirely sure what he intended to say. What is your guess about what he REALLY intended, doctor?"
>
> — Uncle Saul — [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P20](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0020)

## Relationships

### [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adrian-treleaven--uncle-saul.md)

Uncle Saul met [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) introduced them at [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point), where Saul realized Adrian was the grandson of Damaris [Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md). Entrusting Adrian with his treasured life-book, Saul arranged for Adrian to write his life story over a summer spent working at the lighthouse. Their connection deepened through corresponding about the book's progress until Saul's death, at which point he was found peacefully passed away with his life-book on his chest shortly after receiving the completed volume.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P10](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P21](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P30](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0030), +14 more_

- Friend of — corresponds with him about his book  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P35](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN SAUL CROSSES THE BAR P5](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0005)</sub>

### [Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ambrose--uncle-saul.md)

Uncle Saul and [Ambrose Kerr](../character/ambrose.md) are local acquaintances and fishing companions who spend time together around [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point). Saul shared the story of Ambrose's political vow with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and hosted [Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md) at the lighthouse for a New Year's Eve celebration. Saul also celebrated with [Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md) when the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) party finally won the election, prompting [Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md) to shave his beard.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P19](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P23](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0023), +11 more_
